# Code of Conduct

Anyone Can Code should be welcoming to people with different levels of technical experience.

## Expected Behavior

- Be respectful and specific.
- Assume good intent while still asking for evidence.
- Help non-technical users participate without talking down to them.
- Keep issues and pull requests focused on the project.

## Unacceptable Behavior

- Harassment, insults, or personal attacks.
- Sharing private data, secrets, or exploit details in public threads.
- Repeated off-topic comments after being asked to stop.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may edit, hide, lock, or remove content that harms the project or its users. Serious or repeated violations may result in blocked participation.
